_comment: Config for sdp_customer_pipeline.py (@dlt API). Tables are prefixed dlt_ so they do not clash with the dp pipeline in the same schema.

source.schema: c_custkey INT, c_name STRING, c_address STRING, c_nationkey INT, c_phone STRING, c_acctbal DOUBLE, c_mktsegment STRING, c_comment STRING

bronze.comment: Raw customer records ingested from ADLS CSV files via Auto Loader (dlt pipeline).

silver.comment: Cleaned and enriched customer data (dlt pipeline). Nulls dropped, segment upper-cased, ingest_date added.

drop.valid_name: c_name IS NOT NULL AND c_name != ''
